method: Use plain, uncoated oven-ready chips without batter. Preheat the oven to the temperature on the oven-chips packet, commonly 220°C conventional or 200°C fan; use the packet setting if different. Spread enough oven chips on a tray in one layer to provide a 250g cooked portion, without adding extra oil, and bake for the packet time, usually about 20–30 minutes, turning halfway. They should be crisp and golden rather than dark brown. Weigh out 250g after cooking for this serving; the ingredient amount and nutrition use cooked chip weight.

Slice the red onion and mixed peppers thinly. Heat half of the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Cook the vegetables for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened with a little colour; transfer to a clean bowl.
Mix the measured light mayonnaise, tomato ketchup and wholegrain mustard in a clean small bowl. Keep this finishing sauce separate from the uncooked filling and refrigerated until assembly.
Drain the firm tofu, pat it dry and cut it into 2cm cubes. Use clean utensils for the cooked tofu.

Add the remaining half of the measured olive oil to the non-stick frying pan. Cook the tofu cubes over a medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, turning so several faces become golden and the centre is hot. Follow any longer cooking instruction on the tofu pack.
Return the cooked red onion and mixed peppers to the pan for 1–2 minutes, turning gently until hot.

Pile the crisp oven chips onto a plate and spoon over the browned tofu cubes, the red onion and peppers. Drizzle the cold finishing sauce over the top after cooking. Serve immediately while the chips are crisp.

review.notes: Golden firm tofu cubes with softened red onion and mixed peppers over plain golden chips, pale pink cold mixed finishing sauce containing mustard grains drizzled above; no cheese or fresh garnish. Believable single serving and central composition with crop margins.
